name: locavite-frontend
description: Application web Angular 18 de la plateforme LocaVite

scripts.test: node -e "if (!process.env.CHROME_BIN) { const fs = require('fs'); const edge = 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge.exe'; if (fs.existsSync(edge)) process.env.CHROME_BIN = edge; } const res = require('child_process').spawnSync('ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: process.env }); process.exit(res.status ?? 0);"
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; require('child_process').spawnSync('npx cypress run', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true, env: process.env });"
